scripts.check: biome check scripts/*.mjs && pnpm run typecheck:backend && uv run --project backend ruff check backend && uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project backend alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:revision: uv run --project backend alembic -c backend/alembic.ini revision --autogenerate
scripts.fix: biome check --write scripts/*.mjs && uv run --project backend ruff check --fix backend && uv run --project backend ruff format backend
scripts.test: pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm run test:deploy && uv run --project backend pytest backend/app/tests backend/tests
scripts.typecheck:backend: uv run --project backend mypy --config-file backend/pyproject.toml backend/app
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run test
